claims.claim: Le Guin says small-town novels are intensely grounded and rich in satire, humour and character.
claims.source: Ursula K. Le Guin, "B-Sides: John Galt's Annals of the Parish", Public Books, 23 January 2017

claims.claim: Le Guin says of the annalist narrator that he will not and cannot mislead the reader, and that he is transparent.
claims.source: Ursula K. Le Guin, "B-Sides: John Galt's Annals of the Parish", Public Books, 23 January 2017
claims.quote: He will not, he cannot, mislead you. He is transparent.
claims.page: essay body, paragraph on Mr. Balwhidder

claims.claim: Kim Stanley Robinson says Le Guin's language is clear and clean.
claims.source: Kim Stanley Robinson, contribution on The Left Hand of Darkness to "The stars of modern SF pick the best science fiction", The Guardian, 14 May 2011
claims.quote: Le Guin's language is clear and clean
